question:
The normal resting heart rate for a healthy adult is:

स्वस्थ वयस्क की सामान्य विश्राम हृदय गति कितनी होती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. 60 to 100 per minute
60 से 100 प्रति मिनट

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A healthy adult heart beats 60 to 100 times per minute at rest

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — 160 to 200 per minute
160 से 200 प्रति मिनट: 160 to 200 is much faster than normal

C — 110 to 150 per minute
110 से 150 प्रति मिनट: 110 to 150 is faster than normal

D — 20 to 40 per minute
20 से 40 प्रति मिनट: 20 to 40 is far too slow

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Count the pulse for a full minute when it is irregular
option_1:
60 to 100 per minute
60 से 100 प्रति मिनट
option_2:
160 to 200 per minute
160 से 200 प्रति मिनट
option_3:
110 to 150 per minute
110 से 150 प्रति मिनट
option_4:
20 to 40 per minute
20 से 40 प्रति मिनट

question:
A diabetic patient is advised to check the feet daily mainly to detect:

मधुमेह रोगी को प्रतिदिन पैर जाँचने की सलाह मुख्य रूप से किसके पता लगाने के लिए दी जाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Early ulcers or injury
शुरुआती अल्सर या चोट

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Daily foot checks help find early ulcers or injury before they worsen

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Height growth
ऊँचाई वृद्धि: Height is unrelated to foot care

B — Hair colour
बालों का रंग: Hair colour is unrelated

C — Eye power
आँख की शक्ति: Eye power is checked separately

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Poor sensation in diabetes makes small foot injuries easy to miss
option_4:
Early ulcers or injury
शुरुआती अल्सर या चोट

question:
An important nursing measure for a patient with pneumonia is to:

निमोनिया वाले रोगी के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण नर्सिंग उपाय क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Encourage coughing and deep breathing
खाँसने और गहरी श्वास लेने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Coughing and deep breathing help clear secretions from the lungs

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Avoid chest physiotherapy
छाती की फिजियोथेरेपी से बचें: Chest physiotherapy aids clearance

C — Restrict all fluids
सभी तरल रोक दें: Fluids help loosen secretions

D — Keep the patient completely still
रोगी को पूरी तरह स्थिर रखें: Immobility allows secretions to collect

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Also encourage fluids and give prescribed antibiotics on time
option_1:
Avoid chest physiotherapy
छाती की फिजियोथेरेपी से बचें
option_2:
Encourage coughing and deep breathing
खाँसने और गहरी श्वास लेने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें
option_4:
Keep the patient completely still
रोगी को पूरी तरह स्थिर रखें

question:
A patient with suspected appendicitis has pain that started near the navel and now localises to the right lower abdomen. The nurse should:

पेट के मध्य से शुरू होकर अब दाईं निचली तरफ़ होने वाले दर्द वाले रोगी में अपेंडिसाइटिस का संदेह है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Keep the patient nil by mouth and report
रोगी को कुछ भी न दें और सूचित करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Appendicitis may need surgery, so the patient is kept fasting and the doctor is informed

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give a strong laxative
तेज़ जुलाब दें: A laxative can cause the appendix to rupture

B — Apply a hot water bag over the abdomen
पेट पर गर्म पानी की थैली लगाएँ: Heat may worsen the condition

D — Ignore the pain as gas
दर्द को गैस मानकर अनदेखा करें: Ignoring the pain is dangerous

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Avoid painkillers that mask the signs before diagnosis
option_2:
Apply a hot water bag over the abdomen
पेट पर गर्म पानी की थैली लगाएँ
option_3:
Keep the patient nil by mouth and report
रोगी को कुछ भी न दें और सूचित करें
option_4:
Ignore the pain as gas
दर्द को गैस मानकर अनदेखा करें

question:
A patient with heart failure should be advised to limit the intake of:

हृदय विफलता वाले रोगी को किसका सेवन सीमित करने की सलाह दी जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Sodium and fluids
सोडियम और तरल

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Limiting sodium and fluids reduces fluid overload in heart failure

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Whole grains
साबुत अनाज: Whole grains are recommended

B — Lean protein
दुबला प्रोटीन: Lean protein supports nutrition

D — Vegetables
सब्जियाँ: Vegetables are generally helpful

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Weigh the patient daily and report a sudden weight gain

question:
A patient recovering from a stroke with right-side weakness should be positioned to:

दाईं ओर कमज़ोरी वाले पक्षाघात से उबर रहे रोगी को किस प्रकार रखा जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Support the weak arm and leg in a proper alignment
कमज़ोर हाथ-पैर को सही स्थिति में सहारा दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Proper alignment with support prevents contractures and shoulder pain

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Avoid any movement forever
हमेशा कोई हलचल न करने दें: Appropriate movement is part of rehabilitation

B — Let the weak arm hang freely
कमज़ोर हाथ को लटकने दें: A hanging arm can cause shoulder injury

D — Turn the patient every 12 hours
रोगी को हर 12 घंटे करवट दें: Turning is needed every two hours

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Involve the family in daily exercises and positioning
option_1:
Avoid any movement forever
हमेशा कोई हलचल न करने दें
option_2:
Let the weak arm hang freely
कमज़ोर हाथ को लटकने दें
option_3:
Support the weak arm and leg in a proper alignment
कमज़ोर हाथ-पैर को सही स्थिति में सहारा दें
option_4:
Turn the patient every 12 hours
रोगी को हर 12 घंटे करवट दें

question:
A trauma patient has cold clammy skin, a rapid weak pulse and falling blood pressure. The nurse should first:

आघात रोगी की त्वचा ठंडी और चिपचिपी है, नाड़ी तेज़ और कमज़ोर है और रक्तचाप गिर रहा है। नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Keep the patient warm and start fluids as ordered
रोगी को गर्म रखें और निर्देशानुसार तरल शुरू करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Warmth and prompt intravenous fluids treat the shock and improve perfusion

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give a hot drink by mouth
मुँह से गर्म पेय दें: Oral fluids are unsafe in shock

C — Sit the patient upright and walk
रोगी को सीधा बैठाकर चलाएँ: Walking worsens hypotension

D — Wait for the pulse to improve
नाड़ी सुधरने की प्रतीक्षा करें: Waiting allows shock to deepen

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Monitor pulse, blood pressure and urine output closely in shock
option_1:
Give a hot drink by mouth
मुँह से गर्म पेय दें
option_2:
Keep the patient warm and start fluids as ordered
रोगी को गर्म रखें और निर्देशानुसार तरल शुरू करें
option_3:
Sit the patient upright and walk
रोगी को सीधा बैठाकर चलाएँ
option_4:
Wait for the pulse to improve
नाड़ी सुधरने की प्रतीक्षा करें

question:
A diabetic patient on insulin becomes sweaty, shaky and confused. The nurse should first:

इंसुलिन ले रहे मधुमेह रोगी को पसीना आता है, कंपन होता है और भ्रम होता है। नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Give a fast-acting sugar source
तुरंत असर करने वाला शर्करा स्रोत दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: These are signs of hypoglycaemia and need immediate sugar

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give another dose of insulin
इंसुलिन की एक और मात्रा दें: More insulin lowers sugar further

B — Withhold all food
सारा भोजन रोक दें: Withholding food worsens the low sugar

C — Make the patient walk
रोगी को चलाएँ: Exercise uses up more glucose

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Follow the rule of 15 and recheck the blood sugar
option_1:
Give another dose of insulin
इंसुलिन की एक और मात्रा दें
option_4:
Give a fast-acting sugar source
तुरंत असर करने वाला शर्करा स्रोत दें

question:
In a patient with an intercostal chest drain, the nurse must ensure that the drainage tube:

अंतःपर्शुक छाती नलिका वाले रोगी में नर्स को सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए कि नलिका:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Is kept below the level of the chest
छाती के स्तर से नीचे रहे

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Keeping the tube below the chest prevents fluid from flowing back

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Is raised above the chest
छाती से ऊपर उठी रहे: Raising the tube allows backflow

B — Is clamped all the time
हर समय क्लैंप लगी रहे: Clamping can cause a tension pneumothorax

D — Is disconnected often
बार-बार खोली जाए: Frequent disconnection breaks the seal

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for bubbling and the amount and type of drainage
option_1:
Is raised above the chest
छाती से ऊपर उठी रहे
option_2:
Is clamped all the time
हर समय क्लैंप लगी रहे
option_3:
Is kept below the level of the chest
छाती के स्तर से नीचे रहे

question:
A patient with suspected meningococcal meningitis should be nursed in:

मेनिंगोकोकल मेनिनजाइटिस का संदेह होने पर रोगी को कहाँ रखा जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. A quiet, dark room with droplet precautions
शांत, अंधेरे कमरे में बूँद-सावधानी के साथ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A quiet, dark room reduces discomfort and droplet precautions prevent spread

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Without any isolation
किसी भी पृथक्करण के बिना: Meningococcal infection spreads by droplets

C — A bright, noisy ward
तेज़ रोशनी वाले शोरगुल वाले वार्ड में: Light and noise worsen head pain

D — With the lights fully on at all times
हर समय पूरी रोशनी के साथ: Constant bright light increases discomfort

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Follow strict respiratory isolation and monitor for seizures
option_1:
A quiet, dark room with droplet precautions
शांत, अंधेरे कमरे में बूँद-सावधानी के साथ
option_2:
Without any isolation
किसी भी पृथक्करण के बिना
option_3:
A bright, noisy ward
तेज़ रोशनी वाले शोरगुल वाले वार्ड में
option_4:
With the lights fully on at all times
हर समय पूरी रोशनी के साथ

question:
A patient after major surgery develops calf pain, warmth and swelling. The nurse should suspect:

बड़ी सर्जरी के बाद रोगी को पिंडली में दर्द, गर्मी और सूजन होती है। नर्स को किसका संदेह करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Deep vein thrombosis
गहरी शिरा घनास्त्रता

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Calf pain with warmth and swelling after surgery suggests deep vein thrombosis

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Fracture
हड्डी टूटना: A fracture causes severe pain and deformity

C — Simple muscle cramp
साधारण मांसपेशी ऐंठन: A cramp settles quickly without swelling

D — Skin allergy
त्वचा एलर्जी: Allergy gives a rash, not calf swelling

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Do not massage the leg, as a clot may dislodge

question:
A diet that promotes wound healing should be rich in:

घाव भरने को बढ़ावा देने वाला आहार किससे भरपूर होना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Protein and vitamin C
प्रोटीन और विटामिन C

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Protein and vitamin C support tissue repair and collagen formation

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Only salt
केवल नमक: Extra salt does not help healing

C — Only fats
केवल वसा: Fats alone do not heal wounds

D — Only refined sugar
केवल परिष्कृत चीनी: Sugar does not aid healing

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Adequate fluids and zinc also assist wound repair
option_2:
Protein and vitamin C
प्रोटीन और विटामिन C

question:
To prevent infection in a patient with an indwelling urinary catheter, the nurse should:

स्थायी मूत्र कैथेटर वाले रोगी में संक्रमण रोकने के लिए नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Keep the drainage bag below the bladder
निकास थैली को मूत्राशय के नीचे रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Keeping the bag below the bladder stops urine from flowing back

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Irrigate with tap water often
बार-बार नल के पानी से सिंचाई करें: Tap water irrigation is not sterile

C — Raise the drainage bag above the bladder
निकास थैली को मूत्राशय के ऊपर उठाएँ: Raising the bag causes backflow of infected urine

D — Disconnect the tubing daily
नलिका प्रतिदिन खोलें: Frequent disconnection introduces germs

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Perform catheter care daily and maintain closed drainage
option_1:
Keep the drainage bag below the bladder
निकास थैली को मूत्राशय के नीचे रखें
option_2:
Irrigate with tap water often
बार-बार नल के पानी से सिंचाई करें
option_3:
Raise the drainage bag above the bladder
निकास थैली को मूत्राशय के ऊपर उठाएँ

question:
A farmer with organophosphate poisoning has excessive salivation and a very slow pulse. The nurse should prepare to give:

अत्यधिक लार और बहुत धीमी नाड़ी वाले ऑर्गेनोफॉस्फेट विषाक्तता के किसान रोगी को क्या देने की तैयारी करनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Atropine
एट्रोपिन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Atropine reverses the muscarinic effects of organophosphate poisoning

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Heparin
हेपैरिन: Heparin is an anticoagulant

B — Digoxin
डिगॉक्सिन: Digoxin slows the heart further

D — Insulin
इंसुलिन: Insulin is unrelated to this poisoning

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Remove contaminated clothes and wash the skin thoroughly

question:
The first step of the nursing process is:

नर्सिंग प्रक्रिया का पहला चरण क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Assessment
मूल्यांकन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The nursing process starts with collecting data through assessment

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Implementation
क्रियान्वयन: Implementation follows planning

B — Evaluation
मूल्यांकन (इवैल्यूएशन): Evaluation is the final step

D — Planning
योजना बनाना: Planning comes after assessment

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Accurate assessment forms the base of good nursing care

question:
Hand washing by the nurse is done mainly to:

नर्स द्वारा हाथ धोना मुख्य रूप से किसलिए किया जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Prevent the spread of infection
संक्रमण के प्रसार को रोकने के लिए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Hand washing removes germs and breaks the chain of infection

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Save time at work
काम में समय बचाने के लिए: Its purpose is safety, not saving time

C — Keep the hands soft
हाथ मुलायम रखने के लिए: Softness is not the aim

D — Improve handwriting
लिखावट सुधारने के लिए: Hand washing does not affect handwriting

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Wash hands before and after every patient contact
option_1:
Save time at work
काम में समय बचाने के लिए
option_2:
Prevent the spread of infection
संक्रमण के प्रसार को रोकने के लिए
option_3:
Keep the hands soft
हाथ मुलायम रखने के लिए

question:
The correct sequence of the nursing process is:

नर्सिंग प्रक्रिया का सही क्रम क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Assessment, diagnosis, planning, implementation, evaluation
मूल्यांकन, निदान, योजना, क्रियान्वयन, मूल्यांकन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The process flows from assessment to diagnosis, planning, implementation and evaluation

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Planning, assessment, evaluation, diagnosis
योजना, मूल्यांकन, निदान: Assessment must come first

C — Evaluation, planning, assessment, diagnosis
मूल्यांकन, योजना, मूल्यांकन, निदान: Evaluation comes last

D — Diagnosis, evaluation, planning, assessment
निदान, मूल्यांकन, योजना, मूल्यांकन: Assessment is the starting point

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Each step links logically to the next in the nursing process
option_1:
Assessment, diagnosis, planning, implementation, evaluation
मूल्यांकन, निदान, योजना, क्रियान्वयन, मूल्यांकन
option_3:
Evaluation, planning, assessment, diagnosis
मूल्यांकन, योजना, मूल्यांकन, निदान
option_4:
Diagnosis, evaluation, planning, assessment
निदान, मूल्यांकन, योजना, मूल्यांकन

question:
When giving oxygen to a patient, the nurse should:

रोगी को ऑक्सीजन देते समय नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Humidify the oxygen and set the correct flow rate
ऑक्सीजन को नम करें और सही प्रवाह दर तय करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Humidification protects the airway and the correct flow gives the prescribed dose

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Use no humidification
नमी बिल्कुल न दें: Dry oxygen irritates the airway

C — Give the maximum flow always
हमेशा अधिकतम प्रवाह दें: Too much flow can harm some patients

D — Keep the cylinder near a flame
सिलिंडर को आग के पास रखें: Oxygen near a flame is a fire risk

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check the oxygen cylinder level and keep it secured upright
option_2:
Humidify the oxygen and set the correct flow rate
ऑक्सीजन को नम करें और सही प्रवाह दर तय करें
option_3:
Give the maximum flow always
हमेशा अधिकतम प्रवाह दें
option_4:
Keep the cylinder near a flame
सिलिंडर को आग के पास रखें

question:
While lifting a patient, good body mechanics means the nurse should:

रोगी को उठाते समय अच्छी शारीरिक यांत्रिकी का अर्थ है नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Bend the knees and keep the patient close
घुटने मोड़ें और रोगी को पास रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Bending the knees and keeping the load close protects the back

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Keep the feet together and lean far
पैर पास रखें और दूर झुकें: Leaning far away increases strain

B — Twist the body while lifting
उठाते समय शरीर मोड़ें: Twisting while lifting causes injury

C — Bend at the waist with straight knees
कमर से झुकें और घुटने सीधे रखें: Bending at the waist strains the lower back

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Use assistive devices and take help for heavy patients
option_1:
Keep the feet together and lean far
पैर पास रखें और दूर झुकें
option_2:
Twist the body while lifting
उठाते समय शरीर मोड़ें
option_3:
Bend at the waist with straight knees
कमर से झुकें और घुटने सीधे रखें
option_4:
Bend the knees and keep the patient close
घुटने मोड़ें और रोगी को पास रखें

question:
Discharge planning for a patient should begin:

रोगी के लिए छुट्टी की योजना कब शुरू होनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. From the time of admission
भर्ती होने के समय से

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Discharge planning starts at admission so care continues smoothly at home

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Only after a week at home
घर पर एक सप्ताह बाद ही: Planning at home misses the hospital's support

C — On the last day of stay
ठहराव के अंतिम दिन: Waiting until the last day is too late

D — One hour before leaving
जाने से एक घंटा पहले: One hour before leaving is far too late

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Include the family and arrange follow-up before discharge
option_1:
From the time of admission
भर्ती होने के समय से
option_2:
Only after a week at home
घर पर एक सप्ताह बाद ही
option_3:
On the last day of stay
ठहराव के अंतिम दिन
option_4:
One hour before leaving
जाने से एक घंटा पहले

question:
The most reliable indicator of a patient's pain is:

रोगी के दर्द का सबसे विश्वसनीय सूचक क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. The patient's own report of pain
रोगी का स्वयं दर्द बताना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A patient's own report is the most reliable measure of pain

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — The nurse's personal guess
नर्स का व्यक्तिगत अनुमान: A guess is not reliable

B — The patient's facial colour
रोगी के चेहरे का रंग: Facial colour may not reflect pain

D — The pulse rate alone
केवल नाड़ी की गति: Pulse rate alone cannot grade pain

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Use a pain scale and reassess after giving an analgesic
option_1:
The nurse's personal guess
नर्स का व्यक्तिगत अनुमान
option_2:
The patient's facial colour
रोगी के चेहरे का रंग
option_3:
The patient's own report of pain
रोगी का स्वयं दर्द बताना
option_4:
The pulse rate alone
केवल नाड़ी की गति

question:
The best site to check the pulse in an unconscious adult is the:

बेहोश वयस्क में नाड़ी जाँचने का सबसे अच्छा स्थान कौन-सा है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Carotid artery
कैरोटिड धमनी

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The carotid pulse is strong and easy to feel in an unconscious adult

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Dorsalis pedis artery
डोर्सलिस पेडिस धमनी: The dorsalis pedis pulse may be faint

B — Popliteal artery
पॉप्लिटियल धमनी: The popliteal pulse is hard to locate quickly

C — Radial artery
रेडियल धमनी: The radial pulse may be weak in shock

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Feel the carotid pulse on the side of the neck without pressing both sides together

question:
A competent patient refuses a prescribed injection. The nurse should:

एक सक्षम रोगी निर्धारित इंजेक्शन देने से मना कर देता है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Respect the refusal and inform the doctor
इनकार का सम्मान करें और डॉक्टर को सूचित करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A competent patient has the right to refuse, and the doctor should be informed

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Hide the medicine in food
दवा भोजन में छिपाएँ: Hiding medicine is unethical

C — Force the injection anyway
ज़बरदस्ती इंजेक्शन दें: Forcing treatment violates the patient's rights

D — Record that the dose was given
दर्ज करें कि मात्रा दी गई: Falsely recording is illegal

⚠️ Exam Trap: In legal and ethical questions ask WHO has the authority to act, not who is present.

💎 PNC Pearl: Explain the consequences and document the refusal clearly
option_1:
Hide the medicine in food
दवा भोजन में छिपाएँ
option_2:
Respect the refusal and inform the doctor
इनकार का सम्मान करें और डॉक्टर को सूचित करें
option_4:
Record that the dose was given
दर्ज करें कि मात्रा दी गई

question:
The average duration of a normal human pregnancy is about:

सामान्य मानव गर्भावस्था की औसत अवधि लगभग कितनी होती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 40 weeks
40 सप्ताह

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A normal pregnancy lasts about 40 weeks (280 days)

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 20 weeks
20 सप्ताह: 20 weeks is only mid-pregnancy

C — 52 weeks
52 सप्ताह: 52 weeks is a full year

D — 30 weeks
30 सप्ताह: 30 weeks is a premature stage

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Expected date of delivery is calculated from the last menstrual period

question:
The first milk secreted by the mother after delivery is called:

प्रसव के बाद माँ से स्रावित पहला दूध क्या कहलाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Colostrum
कोलोस्ट्रम (प्रथम दूध)

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Colostrum is the first milk, rich in antibodies and Protein

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Hindmilk
हाइंडमिल्क: Hindmilk is the richer milk at the end of a feed

B — Cow milk
गाय का दूध: Cow milk is not produced by the mother

C — Foremilk
फोरमिल्क: Foremilk is the watery milk at the start of a feed

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Colostrum should never be discarded as it protects the newborn

question:
The main function of the placenta is to:

अपरा (प्लेसेंटा) का मुख्य कार्य क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Exchange nutrients and oxygen between mother and fetus
माँ और भ्रूण के बीच पोषक तत्व और ऑक्सीजन का आदान-प्रदान

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The placenta supplies nutrients and oxygen and removes waste from the fetus

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Produce breast milk
स्तन दूध बनाना: Breast milk is produced after birth

C — Store urine for the fetus
भ्रूण का मूत्र संचित करना: The fetus passes urine into the amniotic fluid

D — Digest food for the mother
माँ के लिए भोजन पचाना: The mother's gut digests her food

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: The placenta also produces hormones that sustain pregnancy
option_2:
Exchange nutrients and oxygen between mother and fetus
माँ और भ्रूण के बीच पोषक तत्व और ऑक्सीजन का आदान-प्रदान
option_3:
Store urine for the fetus
भ्रूण का मूत्र संचित करना
option_4:
Digest food for the mother
माँ के लिए भोजन पचाना

question:
During the second stage of labour, the mother should be encouraged to:

प्रसव के दूसरे चरण के दौरान माँ को क्या करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Push with each contraction
प्रत्येक संकुचन के साथ धक्का दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Pushing with each contraction helps the baby descend and be born

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Hold her breath for the whole stage
पूरे चरण में साँस रोककर रखें: Holding the breath too long is harmful

B — Sit up and walk around
उठकर इधर-उधर चलें: Walking is not advised in the second stage

C — Avoid all effort
सारा प्रयास टालें: Avoidance delays delivery

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Monitor the fetal heart rate after every contraction
option_1:
Hold her breath for the whole stage
पूरे चरण में साँस रोककर रखें
option_2:
Sit up and walk around
उठकर इधर-उधर चलें
option_4:
Push with each contraction
प्रत्येक संकुचन के साथ धक्का दें

question:
The stage of labour in which the placenta is delivered is the:

जिस चरण में अपरा बाहर निकलती है, वह प्रसव का कौन-सा चरण है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Third stage
तीसरा चरण

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The third stage lasts from the birth of the baby to the delivery of the placenta

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Second stage
दूसरा चरण: The second stage is the birth of the baby

B — First stage
पहला चरण: The first stage is from the start of labour to full dilatation

D — Fourth stage
चौथा चरण: The fourth stage is the first hour after delivery

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for bleeding during the third stage

question:
A newborn weighs 2.2 kilograms at birth. This baby is classified as:

जन्म के समय नवजात का भार 2.2 किलोग्राम है। इस शिशु को किस श्रेणी में रखा जाएगा:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Low birth weight
कम जन्म भार

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A birth weight below 2.5 kilograms is low birth weight

🔍 Key Clues: newborn

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Very large baby
बहुत बड़ा शिशु: 2.2 kilograms is small, not large

C — Average weight
औसत भार: It is below the average range

D — Normal birth weight
सामान्य जन्म भार: Normal birth weight is 2.5 kilograms or more

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Low birth weight babies need warmth, feeding support and close monitoring

question:
Five days after delivery, a mother has fever and foul-smelling vaginal discharge. The nurse should suspect:

प्रसव के पाँच दिन बाद माँ को बुखार और बदबूदार योनि स्राव होता है। नर्स को किसका संदेह करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Puerperal sepsis
प्रसवोत्तर रक्त विषाक्तता

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Fever with foul-smelling lochia after delivery suggests puerperal sepsis

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Common cold
साधारण ज़ुकाम: A cold does not cause foul vaginal discharge

B — Normal healing
सामान्य उपचार: Normal healing does not cause fever or a bad smell

C — Migraine
माइग्रेन: Migraine does not explain these signs

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Maintain strict asepsis during delivery and the postnatal period

question:
The route of drug administration that gives the fastest action is:

सबसे तेज़ असर देने वाला दवा देने का मार्ग कौन-सा है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Intravenous
अंतःशिरा

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The intravenous route acts fastest as the drug enters the blood directly

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Oral
मुँह से: Oral drugs are absorbed slowly

C — Topical
त्वचा पर: Topical drugs act only locally

D — Rectal
गुदा मार्ग: The rectal route is slower than intravenous

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: The intravenous route is used in emergencies for rapid effect

question:
A sublingual tablet is placed:

जीभ के नीचे रखी जाने वाली गोली कहाँ रखी जाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Under the tongue
जीभ के नीचे

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A sublingual tablet is kept under the tongue for quick absorption

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — On top of the tongue
जीभ के ऊपर: Placing it on the tongue leads to swallowing

C — In the cheek
गाल में: The cheek is used for the buccal route

D — Swallowed with water
पानी के साथ निगली जाती है: Swallowing defeats the purpose of the sublingual route

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Advise the patient not to eat or drink while the tablet dissolves
option_2:
On top of the tongue
जीभ के ऊपर
option_4:
Swallowed with water
पानी के साथ निगली जाती है

question:
A patient on warfarin therapy is monitored using:

वार्फ़ैरिन चिकित्सा ले रहे रोगी की निगरानी किससे की जाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. INR
आईएनआर

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The INR shows how well warfarin is controlling clotting

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Urine output
मूत्र उत्पादन: Urine output relates to kidney function

B — Serum potassium
सीरम पोटैशियम: Potassium relates to fluid and heart function

C — Blood glucose
रक्त शर्करा: Blood glucose relates to diabetes

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Teach the patient to watch for unusual bleeding or bruising

question:
A full course of antibiotics must be completed to prevent:

एंटीबायोटिक का पूरा कोर्स पूरा करना किससे बचने के लिए आवश्यक है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Antibiotic resistance
एंटीबायोटिक प्रतिरोध

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Stopping early lets the surviving bacteria become resistant

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Diabetes
मधुमेह: Antibiotics do not cause diabetes

B — High blood pressure
उच्च रक्तचाप: Antibiotics are not linked to blood pressure

D — Poor eyesight
कम दृष्टि: Antibiotics do not affect eyesight

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Complete the prescribed course even if the patient feels better

question:
A patient on long-term steroid tablets should never stop them suddenly because it may cause:

दीर्घकालीन स्टेरॉयड गोलियाँ ले रहे रोगी को उन्हें अचानक बंद नहीं करना चाहिए क्योंकि इससे क्या हो सकता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Adrenal crisis
अधिवृक्क संकट

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Sudden withdrawal can cause a dangerous adrenal crisis

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Improved immunity
बेहतर प्रतिरक्षा: Immunity does not improve on stopping

B — Sudden weight loss
अचानक वज़न घटना: This is not the main danger

D — Better sleep
बेहतर नींद: Sleep does not improve suddenly

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Steroids must be tapered gradually under medical advice

question:
A mother brings her child whose immunisation is overdue. The nurse should:

एक माँ अपने बच्चे को लाती है जिसका टीकाकरण विलंबित हो चुका है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Give the missed doses as per schedule
छूटी हुई मात्राएँ कार्यक्रम के अनुसार दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Missed vaccine doses are given as per the schedule without restarting

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Skip the missed doses
छूटी मात्राएँ छोड़ दें: Skipping leaves the child unprotected

B — Restart the whole schedule again
पूरा कार्यक्रम फिर से शुरू करें: There is no need to restart the series

C — Refuse to immunise the child
बच्चे का टीकाकरण मना कर दें: Refusing is wrong and unsafe

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Track the child on the due-list to avoid missed doses
option_1:
Skip the missed doses
छूटी मात्राएँ छोड़ दें
option_2:
Restart the whole schedule again
पूरा कार्यक्रम फिर से शुरू करें
option_3:
Refuse to immunise the child
बच्चे का टीकाकरण मना कर दें
option_4:
Give the missed doses as per schedule
छूटी हुई मात्राएँ कार्यक्रम के अनुसार दें

question:
Vitamin A solution is given to young children mainly to prevent:

छोटे बच्चों को विटामिन A घोल मुख्य रूप से किससे बचाव के लिए दिया जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Blindness
अंधापन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Vitamin A prophylaxis prevents night blindness and other eye problems

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Tooth decay
दाँतों का क्षय: Tooth decay is unrelated

B — Paralysis
पक्षाघात: It does not prevent paralysis

C — Deafness
बहरापन: It does not prevent deafness

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Give the prescribed doses at the correct age under the national programme

question:
The most effective way to prevent mosquito breeding at home is to:

घर पर मच्छरों के प्रजनन को रोकने का सबसे प्रभावी तरीका क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Remove stagnant water from containers
बर्तनों से रुका हुआ पानी हटाएँ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Mosquitoes breed in stagnant water, so removing it stops breeding

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Keep windows closed all day
दिन भर खिड़कियाँ बंद रखें: Closed windows trap mosquitoes inside

B — Burn candles at night
रात में मोमबत्तियाँ जलाएँ: Candles do not stop breeding

D — Spray perfume in the room
कमरे में इत्र छिड़कें: Perfume does not prevent breeding

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Cover water storage and empty coolers weekly
option_1:
Keep windows closed all day
दिन भर खिड़कियाँ बंद रखें
option_2:
Burn candles at night
रात में मोमबत्तियाँ जलाएँ
option_3:
Remove stagnant water from containers
बर्तनों से रुका हुआ पानी हटाएँ
option_4:
Spray perfume in the room
कमरे में इत्र छिड़कें

question:
A community nurse should advise pregnant women to have at least how many antenatal check-ups?

सामुदायिक नर्स को गर्भवती महिलाओं को कम से कम कितनी प्रसवपूर्व जाँच की सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Four
चार

🧠 Clinical Rationale: At least four antenatal check-ups are recommended for safe motherhood

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — None
कोई नहीं: No check-up misses danger signs

C — Ten
दस: Ten is more than essential

D — One
एक: One check-up is far too few

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check weight, blood pressure, haemoglobin and fetal growth at each visit

question:
The Revised National Tuberculosis Control Programme provides treatment that is:

संशोधित राष्ट्रीय क्षय नियंत्रण कार्यक्रम के अनुसार उपचार कैसा होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Free of cost
निःशुल्क

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Tuberculosis diagnosis and treatment are provided free under the programme

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Only for children
केवल बच्चों के लिए: It covers all age groups

B — Only in cities

question:

गाँव में खसरा प्रकोप के दौरान सामुदायिक नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:

रोगियों को अलग करें और निर्देशानुसार विटामिन A दें

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Close the village school forever

B — Stop all immunisation
सारा टीकाकरण बंद कर दें: Immunisation must continue and expand

question:
The best simple indicator of a young child's growth is:

छोटे बच्चे की वृद्धि का सबसे सरल सूचक क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Regular weight gain
नियमित भार वृद्धि

बालों का रंग: Hair colour does not indicate growth

जूते का आकार: Shoe size alone is not a reliable measure

question:

छह सप्ताह की आयु में बच्चे को कौन-सा टीका लगना चाहिए:

केवल बीसीजी: BCG is given at birth

कोई टीका नहीं: Vaccines must not be missed at six weeks

question:
A child with diarrhoea has sunken eyes and a dry mouth. The nurse should assess for:

दस्त वाले बच्चे की आँखें धँसी हैं और मुँह सूखा है। नर्स को किसका मूल्यांकन करना चाहिए:
solution:

निर्जलीकरण की मात्रा

कान का संक्रमण: These signs do not point to ear infection

दाँतों का क्षय: Tooth decay is unrelated

question:

बच्चे में दमा के दौरे के दौरान सबसे उपयोगी नर्सिंग क्रिया क्या है:

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Withhold all medicines
सारी दवाएँ रोक दें: Withholding medicine is dangerous

ठंडा स्नान कराएँ: A cold bath does not help and may distress the child

बच्चे को दौड़ाएँ: Exercise worsens the attack

question:

छह सप्ताह के बच्चे को दूध पीने के बाद तेज़ उल्टी होती है और वज़न नहीं बढ़ रहा। नर्स को किसका संदेह करना चाहिए:
solution:

पायलोरिक स्टेनोसिस

❌ Why Not Other Options?

साधारण ज़ुकाम: A cold does not cause forceful vomiting

दाँत निकलना: Teething does not cause this pattern

question:

पूरे शरीर में रक्त पंप करने वाला अंग कौन-सा है:
solution:

हृदय

गुर्दा: The kidneys filter blood and form urine

फुफ्फुस: The lungs oxygenate the blood

question:

भोजन से पोषक तत्व अवशोषित करना

रक्त पंप करना: The heart pumps blood

भोजन से पोषक तत्व अवशोषित करना

question:

हीमोग्लोबिन

प्लेटलेट्स: Platelets help in clotting

प्लाज़्मा प्रोटीन: Plasma proteins have other roles

question:

मुख्य रूप से चयापचय की मूल दर को नियंत्रित करने वाला हार्मोन कौन-सा है:

इंसुलिन: Insulin controls blood glucose

question:

शरीर के तापमान को नियंत्रित करने वाला मस्तिष्क का भाग कौन-सा है:

question:

question:

question:

question:

एक रोगी कहता है, "जीने में कोई अर्थ नहीं।" नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:

question:

कल्चर के लिए स्वैब लें और डॉक्टर को सूचित करें

question:

question:

शोथ (एडिमा) किसके असामान्य संचय से होता है:

question:

question:
